WITH latest_snapshots AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (
        SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
        FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    )
)
SELECT h.symbol, h.qty, h.avg_cost, s.sector, s.trading_signal, s.technical_score, s.fundamental_score
FROM portfolio.holdings h
JOIN latest_snapshots s ON h.symbol = s.symbol
